title: MFA Step-Up Request
description: Second-factor proof required by security-reducing MFA operations (DELETE /api/v1/mfa/disable and GET /api/v1/mfa/backup-codes). Supply the current TOTP code or an unused recovery code either as this JSON body or in the `X-MFA-Code` request header (GET has no body, so use the header; never a query string because URLs are logged). When both are given they MUST be identical. A recovery code used for step-up is consumed. Errors: 400 MFA_STEP_UP_REQUIRED (missing/malformed), 401 MFA_STEP_UP_INVALID (wrong code), 500 MFA_STEP_UP_ERROR.

code.description: Current 6-digit TOTP code or an unused recovery code (XXXX-XXXX).
